name: ai-strategist
description: Interviews you about your business and your life, then designs the AI hub that runs them: which Claude Projects to create, what each one reads, and what runs on a schedule.

interface.shortDescription: Design the AI hub that runs your business and your life
interface.longDescription: Interviews you about every business and life area you carry, then writes one Hub Strategy document: which Claude Projects to create, what each one reads, the skills and plugins it needs, what runs on a schedule, and where the results land in your Notion hub. It checks every capability against current documentation in the session rather than working from memory, and it builds nothing without you.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my Notion hub.
What would you need to know to plan my projects?
